backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing user data, streaks, badges, daily resets, penalties, and chat messages with access control.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user data structures to the new schema with updated field names and highest daily questions tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking feature requirements to affected frontend files and components with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and updates of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide detailing steps, checklists, and tests for releasing Version 21 to production on the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling defining themes, color variables, and dark mode rules for the frontend.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the root React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component setting up routing, authentication flow, theme provider, and profile setup modal logic.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Simple admin panel card displaying administrator privileges and backend-controlled features.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Displays a user's badge or a placeholder, with size options, animation effects, and sparkle visuals.
frontend/src/components/ChatDialog.tsx: Provides a chat UI with user list, message history, and input handling using backend chat queries.
frontend/src/components/DailyReminder.ts: Shows a timed daily reminder if the user hasn’t solved any questions, with localStorage-based dismissal.
frontend/src/components/DailyTracker.tsx: Lets users view and update today's solved questions, validating input and saving via backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the main navigation bar with auth controls, theme toggle, user greeting, and chat access.
Fetches and displays daily history with cumulative stats, handling loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays a login page with Internet Identity authentication and animated UI elements.
frontend/src/components/MotivationalQuot: Shows a random motivational programming quote inside a styled card.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for creating a user profile with name entry, success animation, and form handling.
frontend/src/components/ProgressChart.ts: Renders a cumulative progress line chart based on daily history, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/StatsCard.tsx: Displays user stats, profile info, and badges with loading placeholders and a grid of stat cards.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, wrapping AuthClient and exposing identity, login, logout, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user/account operations, stats retrieval, and periodic refetching with dynamic intervals around a daily reset time.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles, light/dark OKLCH color variables, and custom animation utilities for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wiring QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider around the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the user dashboard with stats, daily tracking, admin tools, and loading states based on user profile and admin status.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Displays leaderboard rankings, charts, and cumulative stats using memoized data derived from all user statistics.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them, with fallbacks and error handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, custom shadows, animations, and plugin usage for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes project state and requirements for a streak‑based Q&A habit app, including daily question logging, streak/fine rules, and pending feature requests.
